issues.explanation: Chapter 37 re-narrates the forged letter and Xu Shu's departure, which Chapter 36 already covers in detail, before advancing to the reunion and Xu Mu's death. This creates a noticeable repeated opening across the handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: Begin Chapter 37 with Xu Shu arriving in Xuchang or seeing his mother, retaining only a brief connective phrase that he came because of the forged letter.
